title: Ask to be shown the way
summary: This meets the lonely ache that does not know how to reach the Beloved on its own. The line turns longing toward saint-company instead of private brooding.
takeaway: Let longing be led by holy company.
lifeApplication: When isolation starts narrating the whole room, send the message, enter the sangat, or sit near the one who remembers well. Do not let longing close in on itself.

source.shortMeaning: Grace leads longing toward the Beloved through saintly company.
source.lifeApplication: When loneliness tightens, move toward the company that can point you home.

evidence.coreClaim: Grace leads longing toward the Beloved through saintly company.
evidence.turn: Longing ripens when saintly company shows the way.
